These cataloged content were submitted by either the Google Form or sent a document directly (each linked to in the PDF Report in the Final Cataloging section) which was ultimately then shared on social media. Therefore, the Google Form was one route for sending content but not the exclusive route, which is why the cataloged content is shared in the PDF Report as links to all of the past collected content.
